# Datasets in R

The dataset I am using is this one below. I chose this dataset because I plan on using it for my final project so I might as well get a head start on it!

[https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/abdullahashfaqvirk/student-mental-health-survey](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/abdullahashfaqvirk/student-mental-health-survey)

## R code
### Load Dataset
```{r}
library(readr)
mental_health <- read_csv("data/MentalHealthSurvey.csv")

spec(mental_health)

print(mental_health)
```

### Scatter Plot With Line of Best Fit
```{r}
plot(mental_health$academic_pressure, mental_health$anxiety, main = "Academic Pressure vs Anxiety", xlab = "Academic Pressure", ylab = "Anxiety")

fit <- lm(mental_health$anxiety ~ mental_health$academic_pressure)
abline(fit, col = "red")

```
